title: How Scientists Lived Frozen Into the Arctic Ice for a Whole Year
hook_chapter: A ship that froze on purpose
intro: In 2019 the icebreaker Polarstern let the Arctic ice freeze around it and drifted past the North Pole for a year. Here's how hundreds of people ate, slept and worked through polar night, polar bears and COVID.
asof_line: Figures come from the MOSAiC expedition 2019–2020 (AWI factsheet as of 11/2020).
